# Sanitized BTC activity fixture v1

These are sanitized test derivatives, not connected-provider acceptance. Financial values, original timestamp precision, omissions and ownership are retained. All account, order, client, event, execution and other opaque identifiers are replaced consistently, including embedded JSON and composite fill IDs.

manifest.json records distinct derivative hashes and original-file hashes as provenance. The private substitution table is not part of this fixture. CI requires only this committed directory. This remains a legacy regression fixture. It cannot supply G3-v2 evidence. The accepted prospective amendment supersedes the original-replay prerequisite for replacement qualification; the original case remains unresolved and its fixed assertions stay unchanged. Newly authenticated private evidence must pass the separate G3-v2 procedure before activation.
